forecast_rule: At the end of hour t, rank demand in hour t+24; its count is assumed available 24 hours after the forecast cutoff.
label_rule: Target count >= the training target-count 80th percentile. No threshold selection on calibration, development or final outcomes.
purge_rule: Every training/calibration/development target must finish strictly before the next partition begins.
review_scope: Top 10% across each entire historical evaluation partition; not a real-time operational review policy.
selection: All contracted hours; no outcome-based sampling, candidate winner selection, tuning or final-period refitting.
final_rule: Primary model and comparison family are fixed before the first final evaluation. Later revisions must identify this final interval as explored.
limitations: One historical city-year; not evidence of performance in other cities or future years.
Hourly values are assumed available after hour completion; original publication latency and revision vintages are not audited.
Future weather, future functioning status and future counts are excluded from features.
High demand is a training-derived benchmark label, not measured shortages or a service-capacity threshold.
No operational benefit, causal effect or vulnerability-prediction validity is established.
